question: Who said 'Swaraj is my birthright'?
solution:
The correct answer is __Bal Gangadhar Tilak__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bal Gangadhar Tilak raised the slogan, “Swaraj is my birthright and I shall have it!”.
 
• The word Swarajya was first coined by Bal Gangadhar Tilak.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bal Gangadhar Tilak was also known as Lokmanya Tilak.

 
 
• He established a prominent organization Deccan Education Society to promote modern learning.
 
• He also established Fergusson College at Pune.
 
• He along with Annie Besant played an important role during Home Rule Movement (1916-18).
 
• Kesari and Maratha were the two newspapers started by Bal Gangadhar Tilak.
